source: Authored, de-identified teaching text from the user's requested p_i = x_i P_total, x_i = n_i / n_total, correction, Cue, repetition and incomplete Kc cases. Not private transcript or frozen GOLD. Human review pending.

steps.text: For an ideal gas mixture, partial pressure p_i equals mole fraction x_i multiplied by total pressure P_total. Both pressures are in kilopascals; mole fraction has no units.
steps.expect: Establish a grounded Equal(p_i, Multiply(x_i, P_total)) with pressure units kPa and dimensionless x_i.

steps.text: In that same mixture, the mole fraction x_i is the amount n_i of this gas divided by the total amount n_total of all gases. Both amounts are in moles. Keep our partial pressure relationship in mind.
steps.expect: Establish Equal(x_i, Divide(n_i,n_total)); pressure relationship is necessary previous context, no invented substitution.

steps.text: The total pressure in this example is 200 kilopascals.
steps.expect: Establish the attributable example value without rewriting the general law.

steps.text: Sorry, I said 200 kilopascals. The total pressure in this example is actually 250 kilopascals.
steps.expect: Correct the same accepted example identity; no duplicated stale value.

steps.text: Look at the partial pressure relationship. Before we continue, explain to your partner why the mole fraction has no units.
steps.expect: Grounded teacher Cue targeting the valid mole-fraction/pressure knowledge, visible in the sibling region.

steps.text: So the fraction of moles is the amount of that component over the combined amount of all the gases, with both amounts measured in moles.
steps.expect: Distinct evidence identity; resolved no-change if no new meaning. No duplicated relationship.

steps.text: For the equilibrium constant Kc, the expression would have that concentration on top, and then...
steps.expect: Preserve unresolved meaning; do not invent a complete Kc expression.

steps.text: We will return to the equilibrium expression later. For now the partial pressure of a gas is still its mole fraction times the total pressure.
steps.expect: Live continues with prior unresolved obligation preserved while Stage can review independently.
